title: Google Cloud Digital Leader · Practice exam

format.note: The real exam has 50-60 multiple choice and multiple select questions in 90 minutes, in English and other languages.
format.scoring: Google does not publish the passing score; results are pass/fail. 70% here is an indicative target.

domains.name: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence
Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
Trust and Security with Google Cloud

questions.q: A retail company's leadership asks why moving to the cloud supports digital transformation, beyond lowering IT costs. Which answer is BEST?
o: The cloud lets the company experiment quickly, scale on demand, and use advanced services like data analytics and AI to create new customer value
The cloud removes the need for any IT staff
The cloud is only a cheaper data center
questions.e: Digital transformation is about using technology to change how the business creates value, not only reducing infrastructure costs.

questions.q: Which change in spending model does the cloud typically introduce?
o: From capital expenditure (CapEx) on hardware to operational expenditure (OpEx) based on consumption
From monthly bills to one-time payments for ten years
questions.e: Cloud resources are paid as they are consumed, turning large up-front investments into variable operating costs.

questions.q: Which Google Cloud resources are organized in a geographic hierarchy from largest to smallest?
questions.e: A region contains three or more zones; zones are deployment areas within a region.

questions.q: A company must keep customer data within a specific country for regulatory reasons. Which cloud capability supports this?
o: Choosing the regions where data is stored and processed
questions.e: Location choices, plus controls such as organization policy resource location constraints, support data residency.

questions.q: Which cloud service model gives the customer the MOST control over the operating system and runtime?
o: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), such as Compute Engine
Platform as a Service (PaaS), such as App Engine
Software as a Service (SaaS), such as Google Workspace
questions.e: With IaaS you manage the OS and above; with PaaS and SaaS the provider manages more layers.

questions.q: Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Drive) used by an organization is an example of which model?
questions.e: SaaS applications are fully managed and consumed by users.

questions.q: What is the main benefit of the cloud's elasticity for an online store during holiday sales?
o: Capacity grows automatically during the peak and shrinks afterwards, so the company pays only for what it uses
The store must buy hardware for the peak months in advance
Prices are fixed regardless of usage
The website becomes slower but cheaper
questions.e: Elasticity matches capacity to demand.

questions.q: Which statement describes a hybrid cloud?
o: Workloads run across on-premises infrastructure and a public cloud, connected and managed together
Workloads run on two public clouds without on-premises systems
All workloads run only on premises
Workloads run only in one cloud region
questions.e: Multicloud uses several public clouds; hybrid combines on-premises and cloud.

questions.q: A company wants to run modern containerized applications consistently across Google Cloud, other clouds, and its own data centers, with central policy management. Which offering fits?
questions.e: GKE Enterprise provides fleet management for Kubernetes clusters across environments.

questions.q: Which factor is a key component of total cost of ownership (TCO) that organizations often underestimate when staying on premises?
o: Staff time for maintenance, hardware refreshes, power, cooling, and facilities
The cost of a single server's purchase price only
questions.e: TCO includes direct and indirect costs over the asset's lifetime.

questions.q: What does Google Cloud's global network provide to customers?
o: A private, high-capacity fiber network connecting regions and edge points of presence, improving performance and reliability
Free data transfer to all destinations
questions.e: Traffic can stay on Google's backbone for much of its journey (Premium Tier).

questions.q: Which statement about the cloud and innovation is MOST accurate?
o: Teams can try new ideas with low upfront cost and fail fast, because resources can be created and deleted in minutes
The cloud only supports legacy applications
Experiments must last at least a year
questions.e: Low cost of experimentation accelerates innovation.

questions.q: An organization wants to reduce the carbon footprint of its IT. How does moving to Google Cloud help?
o: Google operates efficient data centers and reports the carbon footprint of customers' usage, helping them choose lower-carbon regions
It requires buying carbon credits from the customer
questions.e: Google Cloud provides the Carbon Footprint tool and information on region carbon-free energy.

questions.q: Which of the following are fundamental cloud computing characteristics?
o: Manual provisioning by the provider for every request
questions.e: These, together with measured service, are the standard characteristics of cloud computing (NIST definition).

questions.q: What is the purpose of a Google Cloud project?
o: It organizes resources, enables APIs, and is the base for billing and access control
It is a physical data center
It is a virtual network only
questions.e: All Google Cloud resources belong to a project.

questions.q: Which part of the resource hierarchy lets a company group projects by department and apply policies to all of them?
questions.e: The hierarchy is organization, folders, projects, resources; policies are inherited downwards.

questions.q: A company wants to modernize gradually rather than rewrite all applications at once. Which approach is recommended?
o: Start with lift-and-shift or move-and-improve for some workloads, then modernize incrementally
Rewrite every application before moving anything
Stop all development until the migration ends
questions.e: Migration journeys usually mix rehosting, replatforming, and refactoring over time.

questions.q: Which statement about open source and Google Cloud is accurate?
o: Google Cloud supports open source technologies such as Kubernetes and TensorFlow, which reduce vendor lock-in
Google Cloud forbids open source software
Open source tools cannot run in the cloud
Kubernetes is a proprietary Google-only product
questions.e: Kubernetes originated at Google and is now a CNCF project.

questions.q: What does 'shared responsibility' mean for a business moving to the cloud?
o: The cloud provider secures the underlying infrastructure, while the customer secures its data, identities, and configurations; responsibilities vary by service type
The customer is responsible for physical data center security
No one is responsible for security
questions.e: Google describes 'shared responsibility and shared fate', offering secure defaults and guidance.

questions.q: A company wants to analyze petabytes of sales data with SQL without managing servers. Which product should it use?
questions.e: BigQuery is a serverless, highly scalable data warehouse.

questions.q: Which product is a fully managed relational database for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server, suitable for a traditional web application?
questions.e: Cloud SQL manages backups, replication, and patching for common relational engines.

questions.q: A global financial application needs a relational database with strong consistency and horizontal scalability across regions. Which product fits?
questions.e: Spanner offers relational semantics, strong consistency, and global scale.

questions.q: A mobile app needs a NoSQL document database with real-time synchronization and offline support. Which product fits?
questions.e: Firestore is a serverless document database with real-time listeners and offline support.

questions.q: An IoT platform ingests billions of time-series measurements and needs very high throughput, low-latency reads and writes. Which product fits?
questions.e: Bigtable is a wide-column NoSQL database for large analytical and operational workloads.

questions.q: A company stores images, videos, and backups as unstructured data. Which product is designed for this?
questions.e: Cloud Storage is object storage for unstructured data.

questions.q: Which Cloud Storage class is MOST cost-effective for data accessed less than once a year, such as long-term archives?
questions.e: Archive has the lowest storage price and a 365-day minimum storage duration.

questions.q: Data is accessed about once a month for reporting. Which Cloud Storage class fits BEST?
questions.e: Nearline suits data accessed about once a month (30-day minimum).

questions.q: Which data types describe information like spreadsheets with fixed columns, JSON documents, and photos, respectively?
questions.e: Choosing the right storage depends on the data's structure.

questions.q: A company needs to ingest events from many applications and deliver them asynchronously to several consumers. Which product fits?
questions.e: Pub/Sub is a global messaging service for event ingestion and distribution.

questions.q: Which product runs batch and streaming data processing pipelines based on Apache Beam, without managing servers?
questions.e: Dataflow is a fully managed service for Apache Beam pipelines.

questions.q: A company has existing Apache Spark and Hadoop jobs it wants to move to Google Cloud with minimal changes. Which product fits?
questions.e: Dataproc runs managed Spark and Hadoop clusters.

questions.q: Business users want interactive dashboards and a governed semantic model on top of BigQuery data. Which product fits?
questions.e: Looker is a BI platform with a semantic modeling layer (LookML); Looker Studio offers free self-service reporting.

questions.q: What is the business value of streaming analytics?
o: Insights and actions happen in near real time, for example fraud detection while a transaction occurs
Data can only be analyzed once a year
It removes the need for data governance
questions.e: Streaming pipelines (Pub/Sub plus Dataflow plus BigQuery) enable real-time decisions.

questions.q: What is a data lake?
o: A central repository that stores large amounts of raw data in its native format, for later processing and analysis
questions.e: Cloud Storage is commonly used as a data lake; BigQuery and Dataplex help analyze and govern it.

questions.q: How does BigQuery separate storage and compute, and why does it matter?
o: Storage and compute scale independently, so you can store a lot of data cheaply and pay for queries when you run them
Compute is free and storage is expensive
It requires provisioning servers in advance
questions.e: BigQuery bills storage and analysis separately (on-demand or capacity pricing).

questions.q: A company wants to migrate its on-premises MySQL database to Cloud SQL with minimal downtime. Which service helps?
questions.e: Database Migration Service supports continuous replication to Cloud SQL and AlloyDB.

questions.q: Which product helps discover, manage, and govern data across data lakes and warehouses in a unified way?
questions.e: Dataplex provides data discovery, metadata, quality, and governance.

questions.q: Why is data considered central to digital transformation?
o: Data-driven decisions and personalized experiences depend on collecting, unifying, and analyzing data
Data has no value until it is deleted
Data must stay in separate silos
questions.e: Breaking down data silos enables analytics and AI.

questions.q: Which statement BEST describes the relationship between AI and machine learning?
o: Machine learning is a subset of AI in which systems learn patterns from data instead of being explicitly programmed
AI is a subset of machine learning
questions.e: ML is one approach to building AI systems.

questions.q: A company wants to add image labeling to its app quickly, without ML expertise or training data. Which option fits BEST?
o: A pre-trained API such as the Cloud Vision API
Building a custom model from scratch
Hiring a team of data scientists first
questions.e: Pre-trained APIs provide ready-made ML capabilities through a simple API call.

questions.q: A company has data analysts who know SQL and want to build simple ML models on data already in BigQuery. Which option fits?
questions.e: BigQuery ML lets you create and run models using SQL.

questions.q: A company needs a unified platform to build, train, deploy, and monitor custom ML models and to use generative AI models. Which product fits?
questions.e: Vertex AI is Google Cloud's unified ML and generative AI platform, including Model Garden.

questions.q: Which data quality issue MOST affects the reliability of a machine learning model?
o: Incomplete, biased, or inaccurate training data
Data stored in the wrong font
questions.e: Model quality depends on the quality and representativeness of the data.

questions.q: A company wants to extract structured fields from invoices and forms automatically. Which product fits?
questions.e: Document AI uses specialized processors to extract data from documents.

questions.q: Which of the following are examples of generative AI use cases?
questions.e: Generative AI creates new content (text, images, code) from prompts.

questions.q: What is a key principle of responsible AI?
o: Designing AI that is fair, accountable, transparent, and respects privacy
questions.e: Google publishes AI principles that guide responsible development.

questions.q: A contact center wants virtual agents that understand natural language and help human agents in real time. Which solution fits?
o: Google Cloud contact center AI solutions (Conversational Agents and Agent Assist)
questions.e: Contact center AI combines conversational agents and assistance for human agents.

questions.q: What is the advantage of Google's TPUs for some ML workloads?
o: They are custom accelerators designed by Google for large-scale ML training and inference
questions.e: Tensor Processing Units accelerate ML computations.

questions.q: A company wants employees to search and get answers across internal documents and applications using generative AI agents. Which offering is designed for this?
questions.e: Gemini Enterprise provides enterprise search and agents grounded in company data.

questions.q: When should a company choose a custom-trained model instead of a pre-trained API?
o: When the problem is specific to its domain and it has suitable labeled data, for example detecting defects in its own products
When it has no data at all
questions.e: Pre-trained APIs are fastest for generic tasks; custom models fit unique needs.

questions.q: Which service converts audio from customer calls into text for analysis?
questions.e: Speech-to-Text transcribes audio.

questions.q: A company wants to detect the sentiment of product reviews in many languages with minimal ML expertise. Which option fits?
o: The Natural Language API (with the Translation API if needed)
questions.e: The Natural Language API offers sentiment and entity analysis.

questions.q: What is 'grounding' a generative AI model?
o: Connecting the model's answers to trusted sources of data, such as company documents, to reduce hallucinations
Training the model only on random data
Storing the model on a disk
questions.e: Grounding improves factuality by referencing verifiable data.

questions.q: Which statement about ML and business value is correct?
o: ML can automate repetitive decisions, personalize experiences, and find patterns at a scale humans cannot
ML always replaces the need for business rules
ML is valuable only for technology companies
questions.e: ML creates value when applied to well-defined problems with good data.

questions.q: Which option requires the LEAST ML expertise to add translation to a website?
questions.e: Pre-trained APIs are consumed with simple requests.

questions.q: A company wants to move existing virtual machines to Google Cloud quickly without changing them. Which approach and product fit?
o: Lift and shift to Compute Engine, for example with Migrate to Virtual Machines
Rewrite all applications for Cloud Run
questions.e: Rehosting is the fastest migration path; modernization can follow.

questions.q: A company runs VMware workloads on premises and wants to move them to the cloud using the same VMware tools. Which product fits?
questions.e: VMware Engine runs a native VMware stack on Google Cloud.

questions.q: Which compute option gives full control over virtual machines, including the operating system?
questions.e: Compute Engine is Google Cloud's IaaS offering.

questions.q: A team wants to run stateless containers that scale automatically to zero when there is no traffic, paying only for usage. Which product fits?
questions.e: Cloud Run is a serverless container platform.

questions.q: A company runs many containerized microservices and needs Kubernetes features, but doesn't want to manage nodes. Which option fits BEST?
questions.e: In Autopilot mode Google manages nodes and you pay for Pod resources.

questions.q: What is a key benefit of containers compared with virtual machines?
o: They are lightweight and package the application with its dependencies, so they start fast and run consistently across environments
They include a full guest operating system each
They can't be moved between environments
questions.e: Containers share the host kernel and isolate processes.

questions.q: Which product runs small pieces of code in response to events, such as a file uploaded to Cloud Storage?
questions.e: Event-driven functions run without server management.

questions.q: What business value do APIs provide to an organization?
o: They let systems and partners interact with services in a standard way, enabling new products and ecosystems
They are only for internal testing
questions.e: APIs make capabilities reusable and can be monetized.

questions.q: A company wants to manage, secure, analyze, and monetize APIs for external developers. Which product fits?
questions.e: Apigee is Google Cloud's API management platform.

questions.q: An application must run on specialized hardware for a licensed database that cannot be virtualized easily. Which offering helps?
questions.e: Bare Metal Solution provides dedicated hardware near Google Cloud regions.

questions.q: Which statement about serverless computing is correct?
o: The provider manages servers and scaling, and you typically pay per use
You must patch the servers yourself
Serverless means there are no servers anywhere
questions.e: Serverless removes infrastructure management from the customer.

questions.q: A company needs to run workloads in its own data centers or at the edge, with Google Cloud services and management, for latency or sovereignty reasons. Which offering fits?
questions.e: Google Distributed Cloud extends Google infrastructure to customer locations.

questions.q: Which modernization path refactors a monolith into smaller services that can be deployed independently?
questions.e: Microservices allow independent scaling and deployment, often on containers.

questions.q: Which tool helps assess an on-premises environment and estimate the cost of running it on Google Cloud?
questions.e: Migration Center discovers assets and provides TCO and migration planning.

questions.q: What is the main advantage of using managed services instead of self-managed software on VMs?
o: The provider handles operations like patching, backups, and scaling, freeing teams to focus on business value
Managed services give full root access to the host
questions.e: Managed services reduce operational toil.

questions.q: Which statement about Google Cloud regions and zones supports high availability?
o: Deploying resources across multiple zones protects against a single zone's failure
Zones are in different countries by design
questions.e: Zones are independent failure domains within a region.

questions.q: A software team wants automated builds and tests every time code is pushed. Which product helps?
questions.e: Cloud Build is a serverless CI/CD platform.

questions.q: Which statement describes Google's approach to the shared responsibility model?
o: Google secures the infrastructure and provides secure-by-default services and guidance (shared fate), while customers configure and protect their data and access
Customers secure the physical data centers
Google is responsible for customers' IAM decisions
Security is entirely the customer's responsibility
questions.e: 'Shared fate' means Google actively helps customers use the cloud securely.

questions.q: What is the principle of least privilege?
o: Users and services receive only the permissions they need to do their tasks
Permissions are granted only to managers
questions.e: Least privilege reduces the impact of mistakes and compromised accounts.

questions.q: Which Google Cloud security model grants access based on user identity, device, and context instead of trusting the corporate network?
questions.e: Chrome Enterprise Premium (formerly BeyondCorp Enterprise) implements zero-trust access.

questions.q: How is customer data protected at rest in Google Cloud by default?
o: It is encrypted at rest by default, and customers can optionally manage keys with Cloud KMS
It is not encrypted unless the customer enables it
It is encrypted only in BigQuery
It is stored in plain text
questions.e: Google encrypts data at rest by default; CMEK and other options add customer control.

questions.q: Which product centralizes security posture, vulnerability findings, and threat detection for Google Cloud resources?
questions.e: Security Command Center is Google Cloud's security and risk management platform.

questions.q: Which product protects web applications against DDoS attacks and common web exploits, at the edge of Google's network?
questions.e: Cloud Armor works with external Application Load Balancers.

questions.q: Which practices improve identity security in an organization using Google Cloud?
o: Granting predefined roles with least privilege
Granting the Owner role to every developer
questions.e: Strong authentication and least privilege are basic identity controls.

questions.q: A regulated company needs to see logs of actions taken by Google personnel when they access its content. Which feature provides this?
questions.e: Access Transparency logs record Google staff actions on customer content.

questions.q: Where can a company find information about Google Cloud's compliance certifications, such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2?
o: The Google Cloud compliance resource center (Compliance Reports Manager)
Only by email request to sales
questions.e: Google publishes certifications and reports for customers.

questions.q: Which product helps discover and protect sensitive data such as credit card numbers in storage and databases, with de-identification?
questions.e: Sensitive Data Protection inspects, classifies, and de-identifies sensitive data.

questions.q: A company wants to reduce the risk of data exfiltration from managed services like BigQuery and Cloud Storage by creating a security perimeter. Which feature fits?
questions.e: VPC Service Controls define perimeters around Google-managed services.

questions.q: Which product helps meet regulatory requirements for specific frameworks (for example data residency and personnel controls) by configuring controlled environments?
questions.e: Assured Workloads applies compliance controls for regulated workloads.

questions.q: Which statements about organization policies are correct?
o: They set constraints on resources across the hierarchy, such as allowed regions
They are inherited by folders and projects
They can prevent the creation of external IP addresses on VMs
They grant users permissions like IAM roles
questions.e: Organization policies restrict configurations; IAM grants permissions.

questions.q: Which security operations offering helps detect, investigate, and respond to threats using Google threat intelligence?
questions.e: Google SecOps provides SIEM and SOAR capabilities; Mandiant offers threat intelligence and incident response.

questions.q: Why should an organization use groups instead of individual users when granting IAM roles?
o: It simplifies management: people join or leave groups without changing policies
Groups have more permissions than users
Groups are free while users are not
questions.e: Granting roles to groups is an IAM best practice.

questions.q: Which statement describes Google's data privacy commitment for Google Cloud customers?
o: Customer data belongs to the customer, and Google does not use it for advertising
Google sells customer data to advertisers
Customer data is public by default
Google owns all data uploaded to the cloud
questions.e: Google Cloud's privacy commitments are part of its trust principles.

questions.q: What is the main security benefit of Google's private global network?
o: Traffic between Google services and regions can stay on infrastructure Google controls, with encryption in transit
It allows anyone to connect without authentication
It avoids the need for IAM
It disables encryption to improve speed
questions.e: Google encrypts traffic in transit and controls the backbone.

questions.q: A company wants to be notified when its monthly Google Cloud spending reaches 80% of a planned amount. What should it configure?
o: A budget with alert thresholds in Cloud Billing
questions.e: Budgets send alerts at thresholds; they don't stop spending by themselves.

questions.q: Which discounts can reduce Compute Engine costs for steady, predictable workloads?
o: Sustained use discounts for eligible machine types running a large part of the month
Paying with a different credit card
questions.e: CUDs require a commitment; sustained use discounts apply automatically; Spot VMs are for fault-tolerant workloads.

questions.q: What is FinOps?
o: An operational framework and cultural practice that brings finance, technology, and business together to maximize the value of cloud spending
A Google Cloud product for accounting
questions.e: FinOps promotes shared accountability for cloud costs.

questions.q: Which practice from Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) defines an acceptable level of unreliability that teams can use for releases?
o: Error budgets based on service level objectives (SLOs)
questions.e: An error budget is 100% minus the SLO; it balances reliability and velocity.

questions.q: Which Google Cloud products provide observability for applications and infrastructure?
questions.e: These are part of Google Cloud Observability.

questions.q: Which support resource gives a company a technical account advisor and faster response times for critical issues?
o: A paid Google Cloud Customer Care plan such as Enhanced or Premium Support
questions.e: Premium Support includes a Technical Account Manager.

questions.q: How can a company attribute Google Cloud costs to teams and environments?
o: Use labels on resources and analyze billing data, for example with billing export to BigQuery
Use one project for everything without labels
Ask each team to estimate costs
questions.e: Labels and billing export enable detailed cost analysis.

questions.q: Which tool estimates the cost of Google Cloud resources before deploying them?
questions.e: The pricing calculator estimates costs for planned configurations.

questions.q: What is the purpose of a blameless postmortem after an incident?
o: To understand causes and improve systems and processes without punishing individuals
To find the person responsible and fire them
To hide the incident from customers
questions.e: Blameless culture encourages transparency and learning.

questions.q: Which statement describes how quotas help an organization?
o: They limit resource usage per project to protect against unexpected spikes and runaway costs
questions.e: Quotas can be viewed and adjusted in the console.

questions.q: A company wants its cloud resources to recover automatically from failures. Which design approaches help?
o: Distributing instances across zones with managed instance groups and health checks
Using load balancers to route around unhealthy instances
Running a single VM without backups
Keeping only one copy of data
questions.e: Redundancy and automated health-based recovery improve resilience.

questions.q: Which service tracks the status of Google Cloud services that affect a customer's specific projects?
questions.e: Personalized Service Health shows incidents relevant to your projects.
